voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: Meet Ravi. His EMI is a few days late.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: This morning he got the same reminder for the fifth time.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: He stopped reading after the second.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: And the lender paid for all five.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: Most collections still run on a fixed calendar:

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: the same message, to everyone, on every channel.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: Costly, annoying, mostly ignored. Kairos fixes that.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: Kairos changes that.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: Every day, for every borrower, it first asks: contact, or wait?

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: And if it's contact, it picks the channel, the time and the message

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: most likely to get a reply.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: Ravi read an SMS but didn't reply.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: So Kairos tried WhatsApp in the evening.

voices.speaker: Ravi (thinking)
voices.text: Need time. Salary late hai.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: Then Ritu, our voice bot, called.

voices.speaker: Ritu (voice bot)
voices.text: रवि जी, क्या आप सत्ताईस तारीख तक भुगतान कर पाएँगे?

voices.speaker: Ravi
voices.text: Haan, sattaees tareekh tak kar doonga.

voices.speaker: Ritu (voice bot)
voices.text: ठीक है, तो सत्ताईस तारीख पक्की। धन्यवाद!

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: Reminders paused.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: When his payment was verified, only that loan's reminders stopped.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: Every step lands in the lender's CRM, with the evidence:

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: Loan A cleared, its reminder cancelled. Loan B stays on track.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: Safety comes first.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: Aladdin, our supervisor, checks every message. Twice.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: Reply STOP on one channel, and every channel stops.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: A fake payment screenshot is caught.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: Lost your job? A person takes over, not a bot.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: And the lender's team can approve, hold or override anything.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: Every step is on record.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: Kairos learns from every reply.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: Midway through a campaign, WhatsApp starts working less well.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: Kairos notices, and switches on its own.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: Borrowers move from cheap messages, to WhatsApp, to a call, to a person,

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: and it learns what works in each region, for each borrower.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: Now, the other side of the desk. Meet Priya.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: Nine a.m., coffee in hand. Today's plan is already done:

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: who to contact, when and how. Nothing to set up.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: Then she just watches the score.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: Runs are rupees collected. Run rate: money per hour, against today's target.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: Partnerships: the channels at work. Wickets: rule breaches. Zero, all day.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: Extras: money saved on messages that wouldn't have worked.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: And ball by ball, the commentary says what Kairos did, and why.

voices.speaker: Priya
voices.text: Zero wickets, again.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: Only the big calls come to her.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: Someone lost their job. Kairos suggests a gentle call from a senior colleague.

voices.speaker: Priya
voices.text: Approve.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: Aladdin re-checks before anything goes out.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: Everything else, at her fingertips:

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: any borrower's story in one click, and why each decision was made,

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: the lender's reports, ready-made, and what Kairos is learning.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: Six p.m. Match result.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: Against the fixed schedule, Kairos brings back about twice the money per rupee.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: Player of the match: evening WhatsApp. Wickets: zero.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: Priya closes the laptop, and goes home on time.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: How do we know? We tested it against the lender's own schedule, on unseen data.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: About twice the money back for every rupee spent, and zero rule breaches.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: Forty-nine of forty-nine attacks blocked. Three in four chats, no human needed.

voices.speaker: Narrator
voices.text: Kairos. Right message. Right time. Or none at all.
